blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines—The Benedicto College Cheetahs and the UC Baby Webmasters emerged as early pacesetters in the Cebu Schools Athletic Foundation, Inc. (Cesafi) Season 26 basketball tournaments, with both teams making their presence felt in their respective divisions. The Cheetahs capped the first round of the collegiate men’s basketball eliminations on top of the standings after stunning defending champions UV Green Lancers, 64-55, on Thursday night, October 8, at the Cebu Coliseum. Meanwhile, the Baby Webmasters maintained their hold of the high school division’s top spot after outlasting the Cebu Eastern College (CEC) Blue Dragons, 47-44, on the same night, stretching […]...
